bio: Beatrice Manfrida was born at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, on 15 July 1687 (some records say the 16th), the daughter of Fabio Manfrida and Francesca Perri. She married Giuseppe Putero in 1709 and outlived him; she was buried there as his widow on 17 October 1765, aged about 78. She is John's 8th-great-grandmother.
